categories.main_business_segments: Ta Ya Electric Wire & Cable Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of various types of wires and cables, including plastic wire and cable, XLPE power cable, rubber wire and cable, bare copper wire, enameled wire, communication and fiber optic cables, and specialized products like ZTACIR cables. The company also invests in renewable energy projects such as solar power generation and energy storage systems, and engages in green power trading through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including the production of long-length extra high voltage XLPE cables, offshore wind power cables, lead-free PVC sheathing materials, super heat-resistant steel core overhead line cables (ZTACIR), eco-friendly flat optical cables, self-bonding triple insulated wires, LITZ wires, high-temperature surge-resistant magnet wires, and thermal-dissipation enameled wires. It also integrates 5G private frequency networks and AIOT smart applications into its wire and cable production lines to enhance flexibility and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include Taipower (Taiwan Power Company) for power transmission and distribution cables, telecommunications companies such as Chunghwa Telecom, and manufacturers in the electric vehicle, drone, robotics, and semiconductor industries. The company serves domestic markets predominantly but also exports to regions including Japan, India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing plants in Tainan and branches in Taipei. It has overseas operations and investments in China (Kunshan and Dongguan), Vietnam, and Hong Kong. Export markets include Asia broadly, with significant focus on Japan, India, Southeast Asia, and emerging markets in Africa and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ta Ya operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing wires and cables from raw materials such as copper and plastics sourced globally. It also engages downstream through renewable energy projects and green power trading, integrating energy generation, storage, and management services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on R&D to develop high-value and environmentally friendly products, including lead-free cables, high-capacity low-sag conductors, thermal-dissipation wires, and specialized cables for renewable energy and electric vehicles. It emphasizes innovation in materials, manufacturing processes, and smart factory technologies such as 5G AIOT integration. Sustainability and carbon reduction are core themes, with ongoing investments in solar power and energy storage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of wires and cables to industrial, utility, and telecommunications customers. Additional income streams include renewable energy generation and green power trading via subsidiaries, as well as investment income from capital injections in related ventures. The company also issues corporate bonds as part of its financing strategy.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Ta Ya positions itself as a leading brand in Taiwan's wire and cable industry, especially in magnet wires and power cables certified by Taipower. It maintains competitive advantages through product quality, certifications, and diversification into green energy sectors. The company actively monitors market trends and adjusts to geopolitical and economic challenges to sustain its market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Ta Ya reported net revenue of approximately NT$30 billion, a 13.8% increase from 2023, with net income of about NT$1.6 billion, reflecting a decrease due to non-operating losses. Total assets reached NT$55.9 billion, with equity attributable to owners at NT$15.8 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and investment in capital expenditures, particularly in renewable energy and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ta Ya emphasizes high-quality, environmentally friendly, and innovative wire and cable products tailored to meet stringent industry standards and customer requirements. Its value proposition includes advanced R&D capabilities, sustainable manufacturing practices, and integration of smart technologies like 5G AIOT in production. The company also differentiates itself through its commitment to renewable energy development and comprehensive energy solutions, positioning itself as a promoter of a friendly and sustainable environment.
